name: Vinnie Paul
description: '''Vincent Paul Abbott'''  (March 11, 1964 – June 22, 2018) was an American musician best known as the drummer of [[heavy metal music|heavy metal]] band [[Pantera]]. He co-founded the band alongside his younger brother, [[Dimebag Darrell|"Dimebag" Darrell Abbott]], which has since been regarded as one of the most influential metal bands in history. After Pantera's original disbandment, Abbott also co-founded [[Damageplan]] in 2003 and was a member of [[Hellyeah]] from 2006 until his death in 2018. Several outlets have ranked Abbott among the greatest metal drummers of all time.
